name: TwinLightReality Viewer
summary:
**One viewer for models, images, and videos, built for Meta Quest.**

TwinLightReality Viewer lets you open and inspect professional 3D models directly in your headset, alongside reference images and videos, for a complete review in a single immersive session.

**Supported formats**: 
FBX, GLB/GLTF, STL, OBJ, 3MF, and DAE — all loadable through a single workflow designed for Meta Quest.
